description: React component for the central panel of a web application, managing views, cards, and user interactions in a board-like interface.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Sets the current card to be shown, clearing selection if needed.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Creates and adds a new card to the board, optionally showing it and focusing on it.

methods.name: addEmptyCardAndShow
methods.description: Adds an empty card and displays it.

methods.name: shouldStartBoardsTour
methods.description: Determines if the onboarding tour for boards should start.

methods.name: prepareBoardsTour
methods.description: Prepares the onboarding tour by updating user config.

methods.name: startBoardsTour
methods.description: Initiates the onboarding tour if conditions are met.

methods.name: backgroundClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on the background to clear selections.

methods.name: addCardFromTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new card from a template and adds it to the board.

methods.name: editCardTemplate
methods.description: Opens the card template for editing.

methods.name: cardClicked
methods.description: Handles user clicks on cards, managing selection and view.

methods.name: hiddenCardCountNotifyHandler
methods.description: Updates notification visibility for hidden card count.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Returns display name for a user based on board group info.
